codeReview.summary: The fix addresses both blocking bugs from the prior review of llm-prompt-injection-hardening: (1) closing </superuser> tag is now filtered by changing /<superuser>/gi to /<\/?superuser>/gi, which matches both opening and closing tags; (2) the closing brace regex is corrected from /\}{{3,}/g to /\}{3,}/g, which now correctly matches 3+ consecutive } characters. Two new tests were added covering both cases. All 243 tests pass, lint passes, and typecheck passes.

issues.description: The comment on lines 89-90 is now stale: 'NOTE: <superuser> must be checked BEFORE generic tag stripping below, because the generic pattern would strip it first, leaving only </superuser> unmatched.' Since the regex now matches both <superuser> and </superuser> with /<\/?superuser>/gi, the concern about '</superuser> unmatched' is no longer valid. The comment should be updated to reflect that both opening and closing tags are now handled. This is cosmetic and does not affect correctness.

summary: PASS — Both blocking bugs from the llm-prompt-injection-hardening review are correctly fixed: (1) The regex /<superuser>/gi was changed to /<\/?superuser>/gi, which now matches and replaces both opening <superuser> and closing </superuser> tags with [filtered]. Verified by the new test 'neutralizes closing </superuser> tag' which checks that neither '<superuser>' nor '</superuser>' appear in the sanitized output. (2) The regex /\}{{3,}/g was changed to /\}{3,}/g, which correctly matches 3+ consecutive } characters instead of the previously incorrect pattern that matched } followed by 3+ { characters. Verified by the new test 'collapses three or more consecutive closing braces' which asserts that '}}}}}' is collapsed. No regressions: all 243 tests pass. One minor stale comment remains on line 89-90 (the NOTE about </superuser> being unmatched is no longer accurate since both tags are now handled), but this is non-blocking.
